message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.0.1 IS OFFICIALLY LIVE! (PREMIERE PRO)**[cite: 1]

We just dropped a fresh update for Flex Ultimate focused on faster transcription start times, crystal-clear progress tracking, and transparent AI model tiers[cite: 1].

*(Tip: Completely close and restart Premiere Pro after updating so your panel loads all the new changes cleanly[cite: 1].)*

♦️ **Real-Time 5-Stage AutoCaption Progress**
Say goodbye to creeping progress bars that leave you guessing[cite: 1]. AutoCaptions now tracks your transcription across 5 live, distinct stages: Prepare · Connect · Upload · Transcribe · Captions[cite: 1]. Progress is tied to actual job execution rather than fake timers, showing your exact file upload size and naming the active transcription engine on screen[cite: 1].

♦️ **Transparent AI Model Tiers**
We simplified and clearly labeled our cloud transcription options so you always know what tier you are using[cite: 1]:
* Flex v1-Flash (Somewhat accurate): Cloud-powered, fastest processing, with zero downloads required[cite: 1].
* Flex Ai 3.5 Turbo (Most accurate): High-precision multilingual transcription for maximum accuracy[cite: 1].
*(Internal test slots like Flex E-TEMP have been completely removed[cite: 1].)*

♦️ **Speed & Logging Fixes**
* Instant Transcription Start: Removed the 3-second pause at the start of every job, making short clips process noticeably faster[cite: 1].
* Accurate Model Logs: The transcription log now permanently records the exact model that processed your audio for easy tracking and credit reference[cite: 1].
